main_text.l: „ in cives facinora facere. Huc accedebat, quod „
Sulla exercitum, quem in Asia ductaverat, quo
si-bi fidum faceret, contra morem majorum
luxuriose nimisque liberaliter habuerat. Loca amoena
voluptaria facile in otio feroces militum animos molliverant. „
Ibi primum insuevit exercitus populi Romani
amare, „ potare, signa, tabulas pictas, vasa caelata mirari, „
ea privatim & publice rapere, delubra spoliare, sa-
cra profanaque omnia polluere. Igitur ii milites, „
postquam victoriam adepti sunt, nihil reliqui
victis „ fecere: quippe secundae res sapientium animos fati-
gant, ne illi, corruptis moribus, victoriae tempe-
rarent.

page.notes: The first paragraph opens mid-sentence, so it continues from the previous page. The „ marks at the start of each line are printed quotation marks for the quoted passage. "quo si-bi": the hyphen after "si" is faint and uncertain. "Asia" is printed in a form close to a Greek-letter look-alike; read as Asia. "mansére": the printed long s looks like f; rendered as s. Italic passages were identified by eye; the boundaries of the italic quotations from Paterculus and Tacitus are not certain. No marginal notes or footnotes are visible on this page.
